note: Wave 4c lane writes-accounts: the writes of api_keys, alerts, webhook_endpoints, support, admin and billing as one scenario on fresh clones of the bed. Run with: python3 tools/parity/api_diff.py --writes --lane <lane> --smtp-port <port> --redis-db-py <a> --redis-db-rs <b> --py-port P --rs-port R --cases tools/parity/api_cases/writes_accounts.json. TZ=UTC so Python stores a naive datetime as UTC, as it does in every container (DECISIONS-RS R6.34). Razorpay is configured with test-only values and an API base on a closed local port, so no call ever leaves the box: a checkout that reaches the gateway is refused by the connection (503) on both sides; the webhook secret is a test value the cases sign with.
